import pandas as pd
import datetime

uv = pd.read_excel("DanhSachDonViTinh.xlsx", sheet_name="Sheet1", header=0)
uv.set_index("Mã hàng", inplace=True)

details = pd.read_excel("DanhSachHoaDonChiTiet_1.xlsx", sheet_name="Sheet1", header=2)
d2 = pd.read_excel("DanhSachHoaDonChiTiet_2.xlsx", sheet_name="Sheet1", header=2)
details = pd.concat([details, d2], ignore_index=True)

details["q"] = details["Số lượng"].astype(float)
# only check rows in uv
sub = details[details["Mã hàng"].isin(uv.index)].copy()
sub["conv"] = sub["Mã hàng"].map(uv["Quy đổi"])
sub["expected"] = sub["q"] * sub["conv"]
print("Rows with conversion, mismatch count:", (sub["Số lượng quy đổi"].astype(float) != sub["expected"]).sum())
print(sub[sub["Số lượng quy đổi"].astype(float) != sub["expected"]].to_string())

# Now compute best-selling for this week
orders = pd.read_excel("DanhSachHoaDon.xlsx", sheet_name="Sheet1", header=2)

def parse_date(v):
    if isinstance(v, (int, float)):
        return datetime.date(1899, 12, 30) + datetime.timedelta(days=int(v))
    if isinstance(v, str):
        v = v.strip()
        for fmt in ("%d/%m/%Y", "%Y-%m-%d", "%d-%m-%Y"):
            try:
                return datetime.datetime.strptime(v, fmt).date()
            except ValueError:
                continue
    return pd.NaT

orders["d"] = orders["Thời gian"].apply(parse_date)

# status normalization
def norm_status(s):
    s = str(s).strip()
    if s in ("xong", "Hoàn thành"):
        return "completed"
    if s in ("hủy đơn", "Đã hủy"):
        return "cancelled"
    if s in ("trả lại", "Hoàn trả"):
        return "returned"
    if s in ("Đang giao dịch", "Đang giao"):
        return "in_progress"
    return s

orders["status"] = orders["Trạng thái"].apply(norm_status)

start, end = datetime.date(2026,8,17), datetime.date(2026,8,19)
week_orders = orders[(orders["d"]>=start)&(orders["d"]<=end)]
print("\nWeek orders total:", len(week_orders))
print("Week orders by status:")
print(week_orders["status"].value_counts())

# exclude cancelled and returned
valid = week_orders[week_orders["status"].isin(["completed","in_progress"])]
print("\nValid orders (completed+in_progress):", len(valid))

# merge details
merged = valid.merge(details, on="Mã hóa đơn", how="left")
print("\nMerged rows:", len(merged))
print("Merged rows missing details:", merged["Mã hàng"].isna().sum())

agg = merged.groupby("Mã hàng").agg(
    ten=("Tên hàng","first"),
    qty=("Số lượng quy đổi","sum")
).reset_index()
agg = agg.sort_values("qty", ascending=False)
print("\nTop 10 best-selling this week (by normalized qty):")
print(agg.head(10).to_string(index=False))
